name: LomboShelf
description: Streaming-style Home shelf, genre browsing and theme for Jellyfin's web client. Needs the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Streaming-style Home for the web client

versions.changelog: Adds optional storage badges, a Keep it longer button and a Travelling card, all off by default. The badge and note show on every visit to a title. Checked in a throwaway Jellyfin 12.4 with stand-in services; not yet checked on a TV or phone.
Maintenance release: same plugin code as 0.1.0 with the CI and release workflow updates. Nothing to change for existing installs.

First release. Home shelf with request and genre rows, collection rows and the theme; needs the File Transformation plugin. Checked in a throwaway Jellyfin 12.4: loads, registers and injects; not yet checked on a TV or phone.
